description: Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council - Appropriation (Amendment) Statute No. 13 of 2017
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of an appropriation statute (Appropriation (amendment) Statute No. 13 of 2017) for the Sabaragamuwa Provincial Council. It involves legal modifications to financial regulations and spending limits, which falls under the category of Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and legislative amendments rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
